ledger.note: Checked the project's FERC approval and local news coverage; they describe a utility replacement in Hampton Roads with no data center named.

A June 2025 Southwest Ledger article says Energy Transfer will connect a planned gas plant for a Chickasha data center to at least one of two high-pressure lines near the airport, but it does not name Enable Gas Transmission, and the plant is only announced.
EIA and the Gulf South project page describe industrial and utility demand in southern Louisiana only; no data center tie found.

A July 2026 Creekstone press release says it bought 43,000 Dth/d of firm Kern River capacity for its Delta data center campus, but it names the Kern River system and not the Delta Lateral, which EIA says serves the Intermountain Power Project.
The Williams project page and EIA row describe storage access and winter reliability; the only data center mention on the page is generic site text, not tied to this project.
